description: Rank up to four exact Derive buy-to-open option previews that reduce one verified net gamma, theta, or vega exposure. Uses the matching owner net-Greek limit unless target_abs_net is explicit. Gross risk and multiple Greeks are not collapsed into a fake optimum. Never signs, funds, bridges, or trades; refresh preview_order before any separate order.

account_id.description: Optional owned child account UUID. Omit for the active account.

asset.description: Canonical Derive underlying returned by get_portfolio_risk.

max_candidates.description: Maximum exact quote previews after bounded chain preselection. Defaults to 4.

max_size_usd.description: Maximum premium and immediate venue cost budget for each exact candidate preview.

target_abs_net.description: Absolute-net target in Derive venue-native position-Greek units. Omit it only when the owner mandate sets a net limit for this Greek; otherwise it is required.

name: preview_derive_greek_hedge
